situation: Two remarks in one discussion both mention caching, but one proposes an index to speed up dispatch and the other explains why syncing tenant configuration is costly.

candidates.claim: Caching tenant queue configuration is costly: every tenant must be synced at onboarding and again on a schedule, and the cache can still be stale when it is read.

evidence.excerpt: We discussed caching tenant queue configuration before. It is costly: every tenant has to be synced at onboarding and again on a schedule, and we still cannot be sure the cache is current when it is read.

incumbents.claim: Adding an index on job_type should make dispatch queries much faster; for queues used only a few times a day, adding a cache is not worth it.
